name: Kamiya Hikaru
source:
Voice Range: Medium-High
Job: Popular Idol

The popular idol with a two-faced personality. He's forced to have a herbivore-guy image by his company, even though his real self is the opposite of it. Even then, he sticks with his job because he loves music and singing.
